pr_title: Bluetooth: service: HRM: fix control point write callback missing
pr_body:
`BT_UUID_HRS_CONTROL_POINT` characteristic was included in Heart Rate service definition with write permissions.
But characteristic write handler is not defined.
This PR add and define control point characteristic write handler, which passes the command to application using callback for further handling.

Fixes: #77596
pr_comments: Rebased branch due to merge conflicts after getting https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/77394 merge.

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: services: HRS write fails with error code
issue_context.body:
Spin-off from https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/73503

Write to the heart-rate characteristic does not work.

> HRM Write:
Write operation is not successful with error message.
Error Message
Android - Error occurred in writing data. Error Code : 3. Please Try again
iOS - Error occurred in writing data. Error : Writing is not Permitted. Please Try again

https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/73503#issuecomment-2309989048 says a write callback is missing in the characteristic definition.

review_comments:
Only if `err == ENOTSUP` right? 

Else a generic ATT error code?
